title: Chapter 77 Xuanling Star Region
content:
Chapter 77 Xuanling Star Region

After an unknown amount of time, A Wei and Huang Shou finally returned to Huangcheng and entered the main hall.

"Meet the Lord of the City."

One of them was a sword cultivator and the other was a sword cultivator, both of them had strong auras.

Seeing the two, Qin Yi and Mu Chen nodded.

Sure enough, there was no ordinary person in this force.

One had reached the point of cultivating the sword with his body, and once he drew the sword, the world would tremble.

The other's sword path had also reached an incredible level, especially that sword, even they had never seen such a terrifying sword.

At this time, Xu Qingzhi was also a little shocked.

The two explored the ruins of the Holy Gate, so he naturally recognized them.

At the same time, he also understood why the other party rejected his kindness.

With such a force behind him, how could he look down on his small Holy Gate.

Above, Lu Daosheng nodded.

Finally, they were the only ones left.

In the hall, several people looked at each other, wondering who the city lord was waiting for.

At this time, outside the deserted city.

A team of people appeared outside the deserted city.

Upon closer inspection, there were more than 20 people, and each of them had an extremely powerful aura, all of whom were in the realm of destiny.

In the Wanling Realm, no force could match this power except the deserted city.

"This is the deserted city."

Looking at the huge city in front of him, Ye Qing said in the front.

At this time, everyone in the back looked at the huge city full of supreme aura in front of them with shocked eyes.

The city wall was made of ancient divine gold, and there was a faint sacred aura in the city.

Ye Qing did not lie to them, there was really hope for revenge.

This kind of power, I am afraid it will explode if you look at it for a second.

Then, under the leadership of Ye Qing, everyone stepped into the gate of the deserted city with trepidation.

"Everyone, my city lord has been waiting for a long time."

As soon as they entered the deserted city, a mysterious strong man appeared in front of everyone.

Looking at the breath of this man, everyone was shocked again.

An existence above the realm of destiny!

This kind of strong man came to lead the way, is this force so powerful?

Then, under the leadership of the mysterious strong man, everyone went directly to the center of the deserted city, inside the city lord's mansion.

Along the way, everyone was already shocked and didn't know what to say.

Is there really such a place in the world?

What kind of person is the city lord of this city?

The creator?

There are too many questions along the way.

And the answer will soon be revealed.

In the hall.

Gu Chen and others felt the breath and immediately turned their heads to look outside the hall.

So many powerful breaths!

And Qin Yi and the other three paused in their hearts.

That, that is?

Soon, Ye Qing and others stepped into the hall.

"Senior, I have fulfilled my mission. I have brought here the surviving warriors from the three great human forces."

Ye Qing knelt on one knee to Lu Daosheng and said respectfully.

In the hall, Mu Chen looked at Ye Qing and the people behind him and exclaimed: "Ye Qing, you, you guys are still alive?!"

Hearing Mu Chen's voice, Ye Qing, who was kneeling on the ground, suddenly looked up.

This familiar voice, could it be? !

"Fuck, Lord Tiandi, you, you are still alive?!"

Seeing Mu Chen standing in front of him alive, Ye Qing was immediately incredulous. Back then, he saw Mu Chen die in that battle with his own eyes.

Even if there was a backup plan, it couldn't be like this.

At this time, the aura of Lord Tiandi seemed to be even stronger than before.

When the people behind Ye Qing saw Mu Chen and the other two, they all reacted.

"Palace Master!! Palace Master, are you still alive?!"

"Master, wuwuwu, Master, am I dreaming?"

"Master Tiandi, please lead us to fight against the Jiemeng again!"

Seeing the leaders of their respective forces, these strong men who had been depressed for countless years came back to life at this moment, and their fighting spirit soared to the sky.

Even if Qin Yi and the other two asked them to kill the Jiemeng now, they would not hesitate at all.

Because their backbone is back.

"Master Tiandi, what is going on?"

At this time, Ye Qing, who had calmed down, wiped away his tears and asked hurriedly.

This is still the Wasteland City, and the Lord of the Wasteland City is right in front of him.

Hearing this, Mu Chen explained it directly.

After learning that all this was done by the Lord of the Wasteland City, Ye Qing and others were stunned. The next moment, everyone knelt down directly in front of Lu Daosheng with a plop.

"Thank you, senior!"

"Senior, you are the savior of our human race!"

"Senior, from now on, my life is yours."

Even their boss has joined the Wasteland City and become the subordinate of this senior in front of them. What choice do they have as younger brothers?

At the same time, they are full of confidence in revenge again.

If they were skeptical about what Ye Qing said before, now they are absolutely 100% convinced.

They will definitely be able to take revenge!

"Okay."

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

After hearing Lu Daosheng's words, everyone stopped and looked at Lu Daosheng respectfully, waiting for the next words.

Looking at the people below, Lu Daosheng continued: "You want to take revenge on the Jiemeng, okay, I will give you a chance, but from then on, you will become a member of my Wasteland City and be completely loyal to my Wasteland City."

Hearing this, everyone nodded repeatedly.

Hearing the word "revenge", all the people from the three forces were like chicken blood, their blood boiling.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng said no more and was about to take them away from here, and at this moment, a shout suddenly rang out.

"Dad!"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng stopped immediately.

I saw Lu Xue and Ouyang Yanqing coming here.

"Hello, young lady!"

In the hall, Gu Chen and others saw Lu Xue and hurriedly said respectfully.

At this time, Lu Xue saw Qin Yi on the side and said with some surprise: "Hey? Uncle, you are here too."

Seeing Lu Xue, Qin Yi smiled awkwardly and said nothing.

And Lu Xue did not say anything more, but looked at Lu Daosheng and smiled: "Dad, are you going out again? Can you take me with you?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, "Xiaoxue, Dad has something to deal with."

However, Lu Xue said a little aggrievedly: "Dad, I won't cause you any trouble, just take me with you."

Seeing Lu Xue like this, how could Lu Daosheng refuse.

This is his own precious daughter.

"Okay, then let's go together."

Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly.

Then, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and disappeared with everyone, leaving only Gu Chen and others.

"What should we do?"

"What else can we do? It's none of our business. Just do what we should do."

"I have a new army to train. Goodbye."

Soon, several people went their separate ways, and the hall became empty again.

.........

Somewhere in the star field.

Lu Daosheng stopped.

This place is extremely far away from the Wanling Realm. It is a fantasy for the creatures in the Wanling Realm to come here.

Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand, and Qin Yi and the others suddenly appeared in front of him.

Looking at the unfamiliar environment around them, everyone's eyes were filled with shock and confusion.

"City Lord, where is this?"

Qin Yi asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "This is the territory of my Huangcheng from now on."

Hearing this, everyone was a little confused.

At this time, a model of a small city suddenly appeared in Lu Daosheng's palm.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng threw it forward.

Suddenly, there was a rumble.

A supreme giant city that could not be described in words appeared out of thin air in this empty star field.

The breath coming from it made everyone present tremble in their hearts.

At the same time, the entire Xuanling Star Field felt this breath.

But for some reason, they were unable to locate the location of this aura. For a time, countless forces sent out strong men to explore everywhere.

They vowed to find the powerful and strange aura.

Because no force would accept this sudden threat.
